name: What is the difference between a custom pantry and a pre-fabricated pantry system?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom pantry and a pre-fabricated pantry system?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom pantry is designed and built specifically for your space, taking into account unique dimensions, storage needs, and aesthetic preferences. This allows for maximum optimization of space and a personalized look. Pre-fabricated pantry systems, on the other hand, consist of standard-sized components that are assembled to fit your space as closely as possible. While generally more budget-friendly, they offer less flexibility in design and may not utilize every available inch as efficiently as a custom solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom pantries are built specifically for your space with personalized design, while pre-fabricated systems use standard components for a more budget-friendly option.
